assumptions.statement: Synthetic replacement brief: 36 by 48 ft, two workshop vehicle bays and rear bench, utility and tool storage, and a two-bedroom residence with full bath and laundry. Exterior stair and deck landing follow the requested access arrangement. Furniture and electric appliances are illustrative choices, not a confirmed real-project specification.

evidence.note: Synthetic concept study; professional review required.

assumptions.statement: The residence is reached only by the exterior stair and deck. There is no opening in the dwelling floor and no internal workshop-to-dwelling door. This is not an accessible route; accessibility and emergency access require professional review.

evidence.note: Synthetic concept study; professional review required.

assumptions.statement: Deck top rails mark guard zones only. Complete guard infill, support posts, stair handrails and guards, slip resistance, frost-safe footings, snow shedding, landing drainage, and emergency escape/rescue performance are omitted or unresolved. Do not build from this model.

evidence.note: Synthetic concept study; professional review required.

assumptions.statement: Envelope, floor, deck posts and beam dimensions are spatial allowances. Clear-span floor and roof structure, vehicle-door headers, deck ledger, bracing, foundations, loads and connections require engineered design. No member sizing or fire rating is established.

evidence.note: Synthetic concept study; professional review required.

assumptions.statement: The dwelling floor is continuous above the workshop. Fire/smoke and acoustic separation, air sealing, rated penetrations, garage pollutant control and an independent workshop ventilation/heating design remain unresolved. Dwelling HVAC does not distribute workshop air.

evidence.note: Synthetic concept study; professional review required.

assumptions.statement: Water supply, connected electrical devices and dwelling HVAC/exhaust are coordination examples. Waste and vent networks, hot/cold separation, condensate, protective devices, final circuit allocation, service clearances and full room coverage review are omitted or unresolved. No conductor, duct, pipe or equipment sizing is implied.

evidence.note: Synthetic concept study; professional review required.
